task_specification.objective: Make the upgrade choice interface invariant under every input mode, complete the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper route on a collision-faithful larger cemetery, and make dense sampling candidate-complete for formal native qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence has three independent seams: focus changes leave all upgrade controls logically visible while the framebuffer omits a sibling card; fixture and ledger coverage has not proven an uninterrupted ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper route; and the representative dense workload exists, but sampling can remain incomplete with zero distributions while the software renderer is also ineligible for native qualification.

stop_conditions: Do not assign or disposition deferred findings finding.arena_camera_occlusion or godot_mcp_rebind_requested.

Do not modify, split, duplicate, hide, reposition, or replace imported children of the intact authored cemetery package; use product-owned wrappers, outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn, objective, camera, and boundary bindings.
Do not count diagnostic jumps, tester checkpoints, synthetic ledger rows, repeated rows, failure routes, or prepared boss fixtures as ordinary-route or build-shape evidence.
Do not accept llvmpipe, another software renderer, an incomplete sample window, or fewer than three native cycles as dense qualification.

Stop after all three candidate acceptance sets are complete, native_godot_project and host_godot_boot remain passing, and recapture plus formal verdict work has been handed to GameLoop Runtime and Tester.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different strategy from the stagnant treatments: isolate per-card rendering instead of tuning shared layout transforms, repair authoritative ordinary progression instead of adding qualification ledgers, bind spatial integrity at the intact package root instead of repeating camera-only tuning, and finalize dense measurements before applying renderer eligibility.

code: Run native_godot_project and host_godot_boot; require clean import and launch with no fatal or recurring GDScript errors.
Confirm the draft retains three independent card instances, stable rects, truthful delta filtering, and no focus-dependent sibling visibility mutation.
Confirm the wave resource declares five ordered data-driven waves and that diagnostic jumps cannot enter ordinary qualification.
Confirm tester checkpoints and dense-profile actions are editor-guarded, absent from release exports, and expose separate requested, resolved, generation, and reset-isolation receipts.
runtime: Tester opens the same draft and traverses A-B-C-B with keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input, then mouse hover and selection; capture framebuffer, card rects, visibility, focus owner, pause state, transaction count, build mutation, and the next changed combat event.

Tester records one ordinary failure for Result and clean Retry plus three distinct successful ordinary complete routes for focused bolts, close-range sweeps, and orbiting area control. Every successful build route must traverse all five waves, defeat Bellkeeper, show Result, and replay; repeated, tied, unclassified, synthetic, fixture, and failure rows do not fill build-diversity cells.

During ordinary movement, Tester traverses the loop, cross-route, central building, landmarks, and all boundary approaches while correlating player position, collision response, navigation, rendered geometry, package bounds, and external-world depth.

On an eligible native renderer at 1920x1080, Tester performs three dense prepare-advance-reset cycles with 25-40 ordinary enemies and the full final-wave presentation; require nonzero distributions, bounded high-churn work, clean reset isolation, and no lifecycle growth.
visual: At native viewport, fullscreen, windowed mode, and supported UI scales, inspect every draft focus state for three simultaneously visible cards, authored silhouettes and icons, truthful current-to-new values, restrained copy, stable dimensions, and non-color-only interaction states.

Compare spawn, cross-route, central-building, perimeter, ordinary-combat, and dense-wave captures with the bound reference for high-angle readability, coherent cemetery density, warm lantern versus cool moonlight hierarchy, readable silhouettes, clear escape lanes, restrained effects, and compact HUD.

Inspect dense frames for distinguishable player attacks, hostile telegraphs, pickups, ordinary vitality feedback, boss health, and movement lanes without placeholder content, clipping, visible void, or landmark-driven disappearance.
